c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
你 and 尔 don't sound similar in modern Mandarin due to historical phonetic changes. They were more similar in Middle Chinese.

你.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 尔 represents the sound.
x: 你今天晚上有空吗？
Nǐ jīntiān wǎnshàng yǒukòng ma?
Are you free this evening?
你们这次旅游是自助还是跟团儿啊？
Nǐmen zhèicì lǚyóu shì zìzhù háishi gēntuánr a?
For this trip, are you travelling by yourselves or with a tour group?
你好，好久不见。
Nǐ hǎo, hǎojiǔbùjiàn.
Hi, long time no see.

因.o: Pictograph of clothing surrounding (囗) a person (大), now written as 裀. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: because; owing to; on account of
x: 昨天的野餐取消了，因为从早上开始就一直在下雨。
Zuótiān de yěcān qǔxiāo le, yīnwèi cóng zǎoshàng kāishǐ jiù yīzhí zài xiàyǔ.
Yesterday's picnic was cancelled because it had been raining since morning.
失事原因不明。
Shīshì yuányīn bùmíng.
The cause of the crash is not known.
投资总是有风险因素。
Tóuzī zǒngshì yǒu fēngxiǎn yīnsù.
There is always an element of risk when making an investment.

无.o: Pictograph of a person dancing, with ox tails or bird feathers hanging from his arms, to pray for rain. Original form of 舞 (dance). The current form is a phonetic loan. The simplified character 无 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 無.
w: not in the least; to completely lack
to be indifferent; not to matter
x: 我现在已经无法直视他了。
Wǒ xiànzài yǐjīng wúfǎ zhíshì tā le.
I can't look him in the eye now.
我没什么事干，正无聊着。
Wǒ méi shénme shì gàn, zhèng wúliáo zhe.
I haven't been up to much, just being bored.
这件事无所谓谁对谁错。
Zhè jiàn shì wúsuǒwèi shéi duì shéi cuò.
This matter is not about who's right or wrong.

加.o: Depicts making loud noises with the mouth (口) to add power (力) during manual labor.
w: to participate; to take part; to join
to add oil; to top up with gas; to refuel
to become a member; to join; to mix into
to reinforce; to strengthen; to increase
plus; to put in; to add
x: 请您准时参加会议。
Qǐng nín zhǔnshí cānjiā huìyì.
Please attend meetings on time.
老板不愿意增加店员。
Lǎobǎn bù yuànyì zēngjiā diànyuán.
The boss is unwilling to increase the number of employees.
加油，你能行的！
Jiāyóu, nǐ néng xíng de!
Come on, you can do it!

几.o: Pictograph of a small table. In simplified Chinese 几 is also used to mean "how much", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 幾.
w: more than ten; a dozen or more
x: 你会说几种语言？
Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
How many languages do you speak?
我几乎未曾离开过这个城市。
Wǒ jīhū wèicéng líkāi guò zhège chéngshì.
I have hardly ever been out of this city.
在没有开会之前，我想请教几个问题。
Zài méiyǒu kāihuì zhīqián, wǒ xiǎng qǐngjiào jǐge wèntí.
I would like to ask a few questions before the meeting begins.

夠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 多 represents the meaning and 句 represents the sound.

张.o: Simplified form of 張. Phonosemantic compound. 弓 represents the meaning and 長 represents the sound.
w: to advocate; to stand for; view
to open up; to spread; to extend
to display ostentatiously; to make public
x: 我有什么好紧张的呀？
Wǒ yǒu shénme hǎo jǐnzhāng de ya?
What have I got to be worried about?
你怎么没有一点主张？
Nǐ zěnme méiyǒu yīdiǎn zhǔzhāng?
Why don't you seem to have any point of view?
没那么夸张吧。
Méi nàme kuāzhāng ba.
It can't be that over-the-top surely.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

传.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 专 represents the sound. Simplified form of 傳.
w: to disseminate; to give publicity to
to disseminate; to propagate; to spread
to transmit; to pass on to sb else
(of a sound) to come through; to be heard
x: 快传太医！
Kuài chuán tàiyī!
Quick, call for the imperial physician!
她的父母很传统。
Tā de fùmǔ hěn chuántǒng.
Her parents are very traditional.
书是传递文明的工具。
Shū shì chuándì wénmíng de gōngjù.
Books are the way in which civilization is transmitted.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

遠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 袁 represents the sound.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.
Originally this component was a pictograph of grass, similar to 艸, but later was reanalyzed as the visually similar 告.

造.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 告 represents the sound.
w: to bring about; to create; to cause
to create; to bring about; to produce
to transform; to reform; to remodel
to create; to build; to develop
x: 这玩意儿□造！
Zhèi wányìr káng zào!
This thing is durable!
急转弯以避免撞到动物是造成车祸的主要原因。
Jízhuǎnwān yǐ bìmiǎn zhuàng dào dòngwù shì zàochéng chēhuò de zhǔyào yuányīn.
Swerving to avoid animals is a major cause of crashes.
房客如果制造噪音而影响安宁，怎么办？
Fángkè rúguǒ zhìzào zàoyīn ér yǐngxiǎng ānníng, zěnmebàn?
What do you do if tenants create noise and affect the (area’s) tranquility?

章.o: Possibly depicts using a blade (䇂) to engrave a block of jade. Based on the original meaning "jade ornament", now written as 璋. Later the meaning shifted to "seal" and "chapter".
w: to break the rules; to violate regulations
x: 我看过你的文章，很喜欢你的文采。
Wǒ kàn guò nǐ de wénzhāng, hěn xǐhuān nǐ de wéncǎi.
I've read your article and appreciate your literary talent.
这篇文章写得多棒啊，背下来。
Zhè piān wénzhāng xiěde duō bàng a, bèi xiàlái.
How excellently written is this article! Memorize it.

素.o: Depicts raw silk (糸) hanging from a rack.
w: element; element of a set; chemical element
x: 投资总是有风险因素。
Tóuzī zǒngshì yǒu fēngxiǎn yīnsù.
There is always an element of risk when making an investment.
素质差！
Sùzhì chā!
so ignorant!

靠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 非 represents the meaning and 告 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "conflict". The meaning later shifted to "lean against".
w: lean on, trust, depend on; near
to rely on sth (for support etc)
to keep to the side; to pull over
to call at; to stop at; berth
to rely on help from sb
x: 请勿靠近。
Qǐng wù kàojìn.
Keep away.
卡车停靠点。
Kǎchē tíngkàodiǎn.
Truck parking only.

c.h: The traditional component 日 was removed for simplification.

习.o: Simplified form of 習. Phonosemantic compound. 彗 represents the sound and 日 represents the meaning. Based on the original meaning "to scorch". The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The traditional component 日 was removed for simplification.
w: to practice; field work; to intern
x: 我想多学习些这个主题。
Wǒ xiǎng duō xuéxí xiē zhège zhǔtí.
I want to learn more about this subject.
我能习惯这样的生活。
Wǒ néng xíguàn zhèyàng de shēnghuó.
I could get used to this kind of life.
这个习俗被一代一代地传下去。
Zhè ge xísú bèi yīdài yīdài de chuán xiàqù.
This custom was passed down from one generation to another.

負.o: Depicts a person (人) carrying shells (貝) on their back.

占.o: In ancient China fortune-tellers analyzed cracks (卜) and holes (口) in shells and bones for the purpose of divination.
w: to have; to own; to hold
to occupy by force; to seize; to dominate
x: 做人别老占便宜。
Zuòrén bié lǎo zhàn piányi.
Don't always seek to profit at other people's expense.
这个公司在海外市场占有一席之地。
Zhège gōngsī zài hǎiwài shìchǎng zhànyǒu yīxízhīdì.
This company occupies a niche in the overseas market.

廠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 广 represents the meaning and 敞 represents the sound.

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

綠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 彔 represents the sound.

誠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 成 represents the sound.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

c.g: be wedged or inserted between, pressed from two sides

侠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 夹 represents the sound. Simplified form of 俠.
w: martial arts chivalry (Chinese literary, theatrical and cinema genre)
x: 我爸爸喜欢看武侠小说。
Wǒ bàba xǐhuan kàn wǔxiá xiǎoshuō.
My dad likes reading martial arts novels.
他最爱看武侠电影。
Tā zuì ài kàn wǔxiá diànyǐng.
He loves watching martial arts films most of all.

c.g: be wedged or inserted between, pressed from two sides

俠.o: Someone 亻 who supports 夾 others; 夾 also provides the pronunciation

c.h: Modern form looks like unrelated 冖.

冠.o: Pictograph of a person (元) wearing a hat (冃). 元 also represents the sound. The 寸 (hand) component was added later to possibly indicate the hat is being held and put onto the head.
w: to seize the crown; to win gold medal
x: 她击败所有对手，荣登冠军宝座。
Tā jībài suǒyǒu duìshǒu, róngdēng guànjūn bǎozuò.
She defeated all her opponents, ascending to the champion's seat.

欠.o: Pictograph of a person (人) opening their mouth to yawn.
w: to be deficient in; lapse; deficiency
to owe a debt; balance due; debts
to owe a debt; the sum owed
to fall short of; to have a deficit; deficit
to owe wages; back pay; wages arrears
x: 老板拖欠我的工资。
Lǎobǎn tuōqiàn wǒ de gōngzī.
My boss is behind on paying my wages.
他因为欠债不还被列入了限高名单。
Tā yīnwèi qiànzhài bù hái bèi lièrù le xiàngāo míngdān.
He was placed on the restriction on high consumption list for failing to pay back his debts.

珠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 王 represents the meaning and 朱 represents the sound.
x: 这位记者突然连珠炮似的发起问来。
Zhèwèi jìzhě tūrán liánzhūpào shìde fā qǐ wèn lái.
The journalist suddenly launched into a bombardment of questioning.
珠穆朗玛峰是喜马拉雅山脉的主峰。
Zhūmùlǎngmǎfēng shì Xǐmǎlāyǎ shānmài de zhǔfēng.
Mount Everest is the highest peak of the Himalayas.

映.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 represents the meaning and 央 represents the sound.
w: to mirror; to reflect; mirror image
to premiere (a movie or TV show)
to shine on; (math., linguistics etc) mapping
x: 这部小说反映了一个封建家庭的败落。
Zhè bù xiǎoshuō fǎnyìng le yī ge fēngjiàn jiātíng de bàiluò.
The novel reflects the decline of a feudal family.

忠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 中 represents the sound.
w: to give sb a word of advice; advice; counsel
to vow loyalty and devotion to
x: 我给你进一句忠告吧。
Wǒ gěi nǐ jìn yī jù zhōnggào ba.
Let me give you a piece of advice.
他对他的爱人不忠。
Tā duì tā de àirén bùzhōng.
He cheated on his spouse.
我属鼠。
Wǒ shǔ shǔ.
My zodiac sign is the Rat.
高校学生食堂吃出死老鼠。
Gāoxiào xuéshēng shítáng chī chū sǐ lǎoshǔ.
A dead mouse was found in college cafeteria food.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

池.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 也 represents the sound.
x: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。
Tā zhàn zài shuǐchí pángbiān, zhèngyào wǎng lǐ tiào.
She was standing by a pool, about to dive in.

惠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 叀 represents the sound.
x: 这家店对学生有优惠。
Zhè jiā diàn duì xuésheng yǒu yōuhuì.
This shop offers discounts for students.
这家饭馆的菜又好吃又实惠。
Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài yòu hǎochī yòu shíhuì.
The food at this restaurant is both tasty and good value.

c.h: 犭 is a component form of 犬.

狠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 犭 represents the meaning and 艮 represents the sound.
x: 她下狠心要把汉语学好。
Tā xià hěnxīn yào bǎ Hànyǔ xuéhǎo.
She made up her mind to learn Chinese well.
老师狠狠地批评了他。
Lǎoshī hěnhěn de pīpíng le tā.
The teacher criticized him severely.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

擠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 齊 represents the sound.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

肠.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound. Simplified form of 腸.
x: 他的心肠真毒！
Tā de xīncháng zhēn dú!
How cruel is he!

眠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 目 represents the meaning and 民 represents the sound.
x: 充足的睡眠对身体很重要。
Chōngzú de shuìmián duì shēntǐ hěn zhòngyào.
Getting enough sleep is very important for your health.
我昨晚失眠了，现在很困。
Wǒ zuówǎn shīmián le, xiànzài hěn kùn.
I couldn't sleep last night, and now I'm very sleepy.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

纠.o: Simplified form of 糾. Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 丩 represents the sound. Originally written as 丩, a pictograph of two ropes entangled together.
w: to be in a tangle; to nag
x: 请纠正我的发音。
Qǐng jiūzhèng wǒ de fāyīn.
Please correct my pronunciation.
我纠结了好几个月。
Wǒ jiūjié le hǎo jǐge yuè.
I struggled for months.

c.g: (same as 廛) living space for one family in ancient times

w: to be in a tangle; to nag
(of an illness, debt etc) to plague sb
lit. ten thousand strings of cash in money belt (idiom); carrying…
x: 他把毛线缠成球。
Tā bǎ máoxiàn chán chéng qiú.
He wound the wool yarn into a ball.
你干嘛一直缠着我？
Nǐ gànma yīzhí chán zhe wǒ?
Why do you keep pestering me?

賠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 咅 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

漠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 莫 represents the sound.
w: cold and detached towards sb; lack of regard
to ignore; to neglect; to treat with contempt
x: 军队在沙漠上空投放了三枚原子弹。
Jūnduì zài shāmò shàngkōng tóufàng le sān méi yuánzǐdàn.
The army released three atomic bombs above the desert.

宠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 龙 represents the sound. Simplified form of 寵.
w: overwhelmed by favor from superior (humble expr.)
to lose favor; in disfavor; disgraced
x: 禁止宠物入内。
Jìnzhǐ chǒngwù rùnèi.
No pets allowed.
宠物被很多人认作是人类的朋友。
Chǒngwù bèi hěn duō rén rènzuò shì rénlèi de péngyou.
Pets are considered by many people as friends of human beings.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

掠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 京 represents the sound.
w: to flit across; to sweep past
to loot; to pillage; to sack
x: 帝国主义掠夺成性。
Dìguózhǔyì lüèduó chéngxìng.
Imperialism is predatory by nature.

坠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 队 represents the sound. Simplified form of 墜.
w: fall down, drop, sink, go to ruin
(of an airplane etc) to fall to the ground and crash
to drop into; to fall into
tottering; on the verge of collapse
lit. a deluge of heavenly flowers (idiom)
weight; pendant; same as 坠胡
x: 桃子把树枝坠得弯弯得。
Táozǐ bǎ shùzhī zhuì dé wānwān dé.
The peaches weighed the branches down.
飞机坠毁了。
Fēijī zhuìhuǐ le.
The plane crashed.
当心坠落。
Dāngxīn zhuìluò.
Danger — be careful near the edge.

c.h: ⺮ is a component form of 竹.

籠.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 龍 represents the sound.

屠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 尸 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound.

悠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 攸 represents the sound.
w: lasting for ages; long drawn out
to swing; to sway; to wobble
x: 中国有悠久的历史。
Zhōngguó yǒu yōujiǔ de lìshǐ.
China has a long history.
爷爷退休后的生活很悠闲。
Yéye tuìxiū hòu de shēnghuó hěn yōuxián.
Grandpa's life after retirement is very leisurely.

赠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 曾 represents the sound. Simplified form of 贈.
w: to contribute (as a gift); to donate
to give a present; to accord (a favor)
x: 他向学校捐赠了很多图书。
Tā xiàng xuéxiào juānzèng le hěn duō túshū.
He donated many books to the school.
买两件衣服赠送一双袜子。
Mǎi liǎng jiàn yīfu zèngsòng yī shuāng wàzi.
Buy two pieces of clothing and get a pair of socks free.
他爷爷是一位老木匠。
Tā yéye shì yī wèi lǎo mùjiàng.
His grandfather is an old carpenter.
这些工匠的手艺非常好。
Zhèxiē gōngjiàng de shǒuyì fēicháng hǎo.
These craftsmen are very skilled.

颠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 页 represents the meaning and 真 represents the sound. Simplified form of 顛.
w: to turn upside down; to reverse
to topple (i.e. knock over); to capsize
to shake; to jolt; to bump
lit. to invert black and white (idiom); to distort the truth…
lit. spirit and soul upside down (idiom); infatuated and head over…
homeless and miserable (idiom); to wander about in a desperate plight
x: 她从此过上了颠沛流离的生活。
Tā cóng cǐ guò shàng le diānpèiliúlí de shēnghuó.
From now on she'll lead the life of a vagrant.

謠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 䍃 represents the meaning and 言 represents the sound.

翠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 羽 represents the meaning and 卒 represents the sound.
w: evergreen pine and cypress (idiom); steadfast nobility
x: 春天，山上一片翠绿。
Chūntiān, shān shàng yī piàn cuìlǜ.
In spring, the mountains are a mass of fresh green.
这块翡翠非常贵。
Zhè kuài fěicuì fēicháng guì.
This piece of jade is very expensive.

叠.o: Clothes 叒 stacked on top of a drawer 冝
w: pile; be piled up; fold up
to overlap; to superimpose; to telescope
x: 她把衣服叠得很整齐。
Tā bǎ yīfu dié de hěn zhěngqí.
She folded the clothes very neatly.
这把椅子可以折叠起来。
Zhè bǎ yǐzi kěyǐ zhédié qǐlái.
This chair can be folded up.

柠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 宁 represents the sound. Simplified form of 檸.
x: 柠檬的味道很酸。
Níngméng de wèidào hěn suān.
Lemons taste very sour.
我想喝一杯柠檬水。
Wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi níngméngshuǐ.
I would like a glass of lemonade.

渠.o: A ditch 洰 made of wood 木; 洰 also provides the pronunciation
w: lit. where water flows, a canal is formed (idiom)
x: 红旗渠动工的那个年代，正值三年困难时期。
Hóngqíqú dònggōng de nàge niándài, zhèngzhí sānnián kùnnán shíqī.
The construction of the Red Flag Canal began during the three years of great famine.

删.o: To cut 刂 out passages from a book 册
w: to abridge (a text); to edit out (of a movie)
x: 删掉这个文件。
Shāndiào zhège wénjiàn.
Delete this file.

蝠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 虫 represents the meaning and 畐 represents the sound.
x: 蝙蝠不是鸟，但是会飞。
Biānfú bù shì niǎo, dànshì huì fēi.
Bats are not birds, but they can fly.
蝙蝠晚上出来找食物。
Biānfú wǎnshang chūlái zhǎo shíwù.
Bats come out at night to look for food.

棠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 尚 represents the sound.
x: 公园里的海棠花开了。
Gōngyuán lǐ de hǎitánghuā kāi le.
The crab-apple blossoms in the park have opened.
阳台上有一盆秋海棠。
Yángtái shàng yǒu yī pén qiūhǎitáng.
There is a pot of begonias on the balcony.

唠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 劳 represents the sound. Simplified form of 嘮.
w: to prattle; to chatter away; to nag
x: 他嫌我唠叨。
Tā xián wǒ láodao.
He doesn't like it how I go on.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

挠.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 尧 represents the sound. Simplified form of 撓.
w: to keep on fighting in spite of all setbacks (idiom)
to scratch; to mess about with; to quarrel
